title: Spectacular
text: It was amazing the food was good and the show was spectacular the best flamenco show I’ve ever seen. Our guide Ian was very attentive and really informative.  I walked away not only knowing the history of flamenco but how to know which wine is the best .
author: sandramX913ZO

title: Brilliant Flamenco and tapas!!
text:
Elevated the tour guide was so passionate and knowledgeable about flamenco it brought you right into the guitar, the songs and the dances.  Excellent front row seats at the flamenco theatre allowed you to witness the dancers close up.

Tapas bars where good as well with dishes picked that we would not normally have tried, but they were so good we would pick them in the future!!

Tour guide was really helpful for other Seville places to visit that visitors would not normally go to.
author: mark_C

title: Must book!
text: Very knowledgeable guide who is flexible and a wonderful company. Jeff also knew much about the local cuisine as a former chef. The tapas he chose were catered to our tastes and were fantastic if you are interested in regional foods, but not limited to I am sure. The Flamenco performance was also amazing and beautiful. Jeff was a great company and is one who I would love to keep as a friend! I would return to the same excision.
author: Amy_D

title: An evening we'll spent
text: My wife and I booked the tour earlier this month prior to arrival in Seville on a short city break. Paul was our guide and we cannot fault his knowledge of Seville and its history which we found both informative and knowledgeable. I think I know the city and its history a bit better now.  The tapas selections were tasty but the high light was the Flamenco show. Fantastic to say the least. I wasn't sure if it was for me but I needn't have worried. It blew me away. We followed this up with more tapas with wine or beer as the nightcap before home. A great evening well spent. Thank you
author: Mark_S

title: Highly recommended interesting insight into Flamenco
text: We had Remy as our guide, who was very knowledgeable and enthusiastic about the art and history of Flamenco. We were a small group of just 3 so we had time to ask our own questions and explore details he gave more. The tapas was excellent, paired with some lovely wine, especially the Orange Wine.  Highly recommended.
